name: razor-spike-mode-syntax-only-records
body: The transitional --razor mode in Main has no semantic model: function names are raw identifiers (no generic arity), params are syntax text, start/end are line-based offsets in the Razor text, and only the first generated class becomes a struct (properties, constructors and nested types in @code are not emitted). Upgrade: phase 7 task 20 routes Razor through Scanner.Run and removes this mode.
